cow.name: Cow (Bovine Vocalization)
cow.description: Beneficial dairy and draft livestock. Low-frequency harmonic moo.

sparrow.name: Sparrow (House Sparrow Call)
sparrow.description: Beneficial insect-eating farmland bird. High-pitch frequency-modulated chirp.

wild_boar.name: Wild Boar (Grunt & Squeal)
wild_boar.description: Major crop-damaging pest that roots out tubers, groundnuts, maize and sugarcane.

monkey.name: Rhesus Macaque (Alarm & Chatter)
monkey.description: Agile troop pest that raids orchards, vegetables, pulses, and maize fields.

crow.name: Crow (Harsh Cawing)
crow.description: Scavenger bird that consumes sown seeds, ripening grains, and seedlings.

deer.name: Spotted Deer / Nilgai (Snort & Bark)
deer.description: Nocturnal ungulate that grazes young crop leaves, cotton, and pulses.

rodent.name: Field Rat / Rodent (High Squeak)
rodent.description: Gnaws roots, stalks, and stored produce in field burrows.

farm_machinery.name: Farm Machinery (Tractor / Pump)
farm_machinery.description: Continuous low-frequency diesel engine and water pump hum.

wind_rain.name: Weather Noise (Wind & Rain)
wind_rain.description: Broadband ambient turbulence and precipitation background noise.

human_voice.name: Human Voice (Farmer Speech)
human_voice.description: Farmer speech or bystander calls across the field.
